text:
zara.marketing: Quick priority ask for launch week: can runtime run a prioritized mini bench (N=60) targeting the quantized candidate we want to cite in the blog? Need clean p50/p95/p99 numbers + coldstart snapshot for the press kit. cc @sam.runtime @devon.eng

sam.runtime: Happy to. A couple clarifying Qs: which quant profile and what baseline do you want compared? Also confirm payload distribution (same samplepack or new slices), and whether dynamic batching should be on.

zara.marketing: Use quant profile q4_3-v1 (we've flagged it as the preferred quant). Baseline: int8-fp16 hybrid (the usual internal baseline). Use the current marketing samplepack but include the "long-context" slice (seq_len>3k) and the interactive slice. Keep dynamic batching=auto so numbers reflect production. We want: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, estimated $/1M tokens (cost/token), coldstart histogram, and 30 anonymized raw traces for slide callouts. Also send KV prefix hit rate and per-host warmup counts.

devon.eng: We'll need exact model name + tokenizer + seed. Also: do you want prefix caching enabled for the main run? That will change coldstart a lot. If you want a coldstart comparison, we can run cache=on (production) and a short cache=off slice.

zara.marketing: Model: redwood-alpha-8k (rev 12). Tokenizer: rwd-tokenizer-v4. Seed: 2026. Yes keep prefix/KV cache=ON for the primary run; please also include a short cache=OFF coldstart slice (10 samples) with --warmup 0.

kai.metrics: Deadline check: when do you need the artifacts? Also specify preferred deliverable format (CSV + JSON + short PPT slide-ready PNGs?).

zara.marketing: Need artifacts by Tuesday 18:00 PT for the internal rehearsal. Deliver: 1) CSV with percentile table and cost calcs, 2) raw JSON traces (anonymized), 3) a coldstart heatmap PNG, 4) a 1-slide PDF with the p50/p95/p99 table and delta vs baseline. Put everything in /share/marketing/launch-bench/1721002222/ and mark as "embargoed" until launch.

sam.runtime: Plan: prioritized job tomorrow 06:00 UTC. We'll run cohort=mini60 seed=2026 variants="q4_3-v1,int8-fp16" context=8192 batching=auto cache=on. We'll add a dedicated coldstart slice with cache=off --warmup 0 (10 samples). We'll compute cost/token using our standard price table and include delta columns. ETA total runtime ~2h. If queue pressure, we'll run a 1h prioritized pass producing percentiles and heatmap, then backfill raw traces later.

sam.runtime: Command we'll use:
```
enqueue-bench --cohort mini60 --seed 2026 --model redwood-alpha-8k --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v4 --variants "q4_3-v1,int8-fp16" --context 8192 --batching auto --cache on --tags marketing,embargoed,priority
```

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued: #3499 by sam.runtime 9status: pending runners (link: https://rundashboard/jobs/3499)

sam.runtime: Note: our runner warmup default is 2 per host. We'll annotate the artifact with warmup counts per host and include a small table showing how warmup affects p50/p95 on the long-context slice. Also we'll attach the exact run config and the seed used so runs are reproducible.

zara.marketing: Love that. Please ensure the raw traces are scrubbed of any PII and replace user identifiers with stable pseudonyms. Also add an annotations file explaining sample slices used (interactive,long-context,short).

devon.eng: Quick FYI: quant q4_3-v1 is slightly noisier on the >4k tails; we'll include bootstrap confidence intervals in the CSV so press figures are conservative.

kai.metrics: Will double-check cost calc methodology and sanity-check the delta column before you hand off.

sam.runtime: Will ping here when artifacts land at /share/marketing/launch-bench/1721002222/. If anything blocks the prioritized pass, we'll fallback to a 30-sample smoke run to give you p50/p95 quick numbers for the rehearsal.

zara.marketing: Perfect. Thanks team 9appreciate the quick turn. Please tag me when the artifacts are uploaded so I can lock the press lines and rehearsal deck. :raised_hands:
